caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate ceramic pitcher positioned centrally on a plain light background. The pitcher is brown, with glossy highlights suggesting a glazed surface, and features intricate decorative patterns including floral motifs and leaf designs in relief around its body and neck. The top rim and spout of the pitcher are slightly flared, with the interior shaded in a greenish hue. The handle is curved and elaborately shaped, matching the brown color and glossy texture of the rest of the pitcher. Below the pitcher, the name "J.J. O'Neill" is written. In the bottom right corner, there is a circular stamp that reads “SALAMANDER WORKS, COPELAND SLATE, NEW-YORK.” The background is otherwise unadorned and light-colored, with no additional objects present.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
